youtube_title: Northwest Flight 2501, 1950: the airliner Lake Michigan never gave back
body: 58 people were lost over Lake Michigan, and the plane has never been found. On June 23, 1950, Northwest Flight 2501 took off from New York, bound for Seattle. Just after midnight, over Lake Michigan, it flew into a storm. Then it went silent. All 58 people on board were lost; at the time, it was the deadliest commercial airline crash in American history. Debris washed ashore near South Haven, Michigan. In 2025, the Michigan Shipwreck Research Association ended its 20-year search. It never found the wreck. Some call these waters the Lake Michigan Triangle. Comment your town for the next La Porte After Dark. #LakeMichigan #SouthHaven #Flight2501 #Mystery #History #LaPorteAfterDark
